items.title: MI5 chief warns of threats to UK from Russia, Iran and AI
items.summary: Sir Ken McCallum says operations to tackle terrorism and state threats are now roughly of an "equal scale".

items.title: Man killed in tiger attack identified as William Chapman
items.summary: A health and safety investigation is under way at Yorkshire Wildlife Park following the incident.

items.title: Football regulator says he would quit over any political interference in Man City case
items.summary: The head of English football's independent regulator says he will resign if he encounters any political interference over Manchester City's future.

items.title: Trump ousts Kimberly Guilfoyle as US ambassador to Greece after corruption allegations
items.summary: Guilfoyle the allegations of improper conduct are "false" and being ambassador was the "honour of a lifetime".

items.title: Three things we've learnt about the UK economy from the IMF
items.summary: The influential economics body has upgraded its UK growth forecast for this year, but risks remain.

items.title: Cornell bans all fraternity parties over gang sex assault allegations
items.summary: The school has faced an uproar over how it handled assault allegations brought by a woman known as Jane Doe.

items.title: Ex-gang boss sentenced to 40 years for orchestrating Tupac Shakur's murder
items.summary: The sentence marks an end to the mystery around Tupac's cold case, which has intrigued hip-hop fans for nearly 30 years.

items.title: 'If we don't scream, they won't listen to us': Student protesters speak to BBC in Paris
items.summary: Student protesters in France have told the BBC's James Waterhouse that they will continue to take action until change has been made. The protests have now entered their fourth week.
